name: Sova
source: The age and true origin of the character are unknown. Unlike other animals, the Owl has few anthropomorphic features, and it looks more like a huge owl than a human. Like ordinary birds, the Owl has a pair of wings, and its body has thick plumage, although it is not known whether these attributes of appearance are genuine or just part of the costume, since trousers and boots can be seen on the Owl's legs. She wears an owl mask with eye slits in her pupils. The owl is much lower than the other characters and the lowest of the animals. She speaks in a deep, distorted voice, accompanied by owlish hoots.
